# CSS/DOM conformance — EXPECTATIONS

*GENERATED by `npm run conformance:report`. Do not edit — edit the case
directories under `conformance/cases/` and re-run.*

This is the **living capability matrix**: what the computed-capture pipeline
does with each CSS/DOM construct, measured rather than asserted. Every row is a
synthetic case whose expected disposition was declared **in advance**, in a
manifest that is deliberately independent of the engine — not derived from
`isFusable`, `styled`, `DECLARED_CHANNELS`, `CHANNEL_TO_COMPUTED`,
`TOKEN_CHANNELS` or `carriedParts`. A construct that is neither carried nor
named-refused is a hard failure here, where in every other instrument in this
repo it is simply absent from the denominator and scores 100%.

## The numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| cases | **53** |
| 🟢 pass | **37** |
| 🔴 red | **11** |
| 🟡 yellow (UNSUPPORTED, never read) | **5** |
| **UNSUPPORTED declared — THE RATCHET** | **19** · may only DECREASE without an explicit manifest edit |

Declared dispositions: CARRIED 21 · LOWERED 2 · REFUSED 11 · UNSUPPORTED 19.

**A green gate here would mean the cases are too easy.** The point of the
fixture is a measured frontier, and every red below is an open, named defect —
recorded in `conformance/BASELINE.json` so it cannot drift in either direction:
a new red is a regression, and a red that becomes green must be re-recorded, so
a fix can never be absorbed silently.

## SILENT-LOSS 🔴 — 3

The class the fixture exists to catch, and the only one that is **never waivable**.
The construct is observable in `captured-truth.json`, absent from the contract, and
named by no string in the union of `LEDGER.md`, the receipt/refusal arrays of
`enriched.extension.json`, `review-queue.json`, `source-bindings.json.skips`,
`scorecard.json` `namedLosses`, and the run's stdout. The pipeline read the fact,
dropped it, and said nothing.

### `calc-var`

- **construct** — `padding-left: calc(var(--cf-space-2) * 2)`
- **why it matters** — Density scales are computed, not literal. calc() over a token is how every compact mode ships.
- **declared** LOWERED by the name `calc` in source-bindings.json.skips
- **measured** — channel `padding-left`; observed on `root`; carried as `root.tokens = 16px`
- **canvas** — PRESENT: the resolved px is right; the token name is at risk
- **verdict** — 🔴 **SILENT-LOSS**: the value is carried but the NAME is lowered away, and no artifact refers to "padding-left" at all — the receipt asserts completeness over a loss it just took

### `webkit-line-clamp`

- **construct** — `-webkit-line-clamp: 2 + -webkit-box-orient: vertical`
- **why it matters** — Multi-line truncation. Still the ONLY cross-browser spelling, so every card description uses it.
- **declared** UNSUPPORTED by the name `-webkit-line-clamp` in LEDGER.md
- **measured** — channel `-webkit-line-clamp`; observed on `root`; carried **not at all**
- **canvas** — PRESENT: Figma textTruncation + maxLines is an exact match — this one IS canvas-expressible
- **verdict** — 🔴 **SILENT-LOSS**: observed in captured-truth.json, absent from the contract, named by NOTHING

### `webkit-text-fill-color`

- **construct** — `-webkit-text-fill-color OVERRIDING color`
- **why it matters** — A disabled input’s grey text: the painted colour is the fill, NOT `color`. Carrying `color` carries a lie.
- **declared** UNSUPPORTED by the name `-webkit-text-fill-color` in LEDGER.md
- **measured** — channel `-webkit-text-fill-color`; observed on `root`; carried **not at all**
- **canvas** — PRESENT: the text fill IS the ink the canvas draws
- **verdict** — 🔴 **SILENT-LOSS**: observed in captured-truth.json, absent from the contract, named by NOTHING

The production runner **threw** on this case and wrote no artifacts. The refusal is
loud and precisely named — but it is a whole-round stop, not a per-construct
receipt. A real library that ships this construct on one component cannot be
onboarded at all, and the failure gives no way to proceed past it.

## UNDECLARED-CARRY (HARMFUL) 🔴 — 4

The engine carried a construct the manifest says has **no canvas spelling**. The
doctrine calls UNDECLARED-CARRY "good news, wrong manifest" — and usually it is.
It is not, when the thing carried cannot be drawn: then the carriage is the defect
and the manifest was right. Fixing these means changing the engine, not the
manifest.

### `container-query`

- **construct** — `@container (min-inline-size: 100px) { … }`
- **why it matters** — Container queries are how 2026-era libraries do responsive components. The rule MATCHES here.
- **declared** UNSUPPORTED by the name `@container` in LEDGER.md
- **measured** — channel `background-color`; observed on `label`; carried as `label.tokens = #3ca05a`
- **canvas** — ABSENT: a size-conditional rendering is a MODE, not a single canvas variant
- **verdict** — 🔴 **UNDECLARED-CARRY**: declared UNSUPPORTED but the engine CARRIED it — update the manifest

### `media-non-matching`

- **construct** — `@media (min-width: 2000px) branch that does NOT match the pinned viewport`
- **why it matters** — Responsive breakpoints. A capture at ONE viewport measures ONE branch and cannot know the others exist.
- **declared** UNSUPPORTED by the name `unmatched media branch` in LEDGER.md
- **measured** — channel `background-color`; observed on `root`; carried as `root.tokens = #c8d2dc`
- **canvas** — ABSENT: the OTHER branch is invisible to a single-viewport capture — a whole rendering is missing
- **verdict** — 🔴 **UNDECLARED-CARRY**: declared UNSUPPORTED but the engine CARRIED it — update the manifest

### `nonpainting-text-visibility-hidden`

- **construct** — `a NON-PAINTING element carrying text (visibility: hidden)`
- **why it matters** — visibility:hidden keeps the BOX but paints nothing — the harder half of the SVG <title> invariant. MEASURED: the part is carried with text "INVISIBLE-SENTINEL" and declared display:"block"; the visibility channel is dropped as code-only, so the contract asserts a VISIBLE block containing text the browser paints nowhere. The display:none twin is guarded and safe; this one is not.
- **declared** REFUSED by the name `visibility` in anatomy.root.parts.label-2 must carry a non-painting guard, as the display:none twin does
- **measured** — channel `__text`; observed on `label`, `label-2`; carried as `label-2.text = INVISIBLE-SENTINEL`, `label.text = Visible`
- **canvas** — ABSENT: INVARIANT BROKEN: text that paints nowhere is carried with no guard — the SVG <title> defect, generalised
- **verdict** — 🔴 **UNDECLARED-CARRY**: declared REFUSED but the engine CARRIED it — update the manifest
- **what the engine actually said** — `and outside the declared-channel registry — no schema channel today (sample: `normal`, 1 distinct value(s)) - label-2.visibility — value shape outside mintable kinds (color/px/number/shadow/gradient) and outside the declared-channel registry — no schema channel today (sample: `hidden`, 1 distinct value(s)) - state ch`

### `stage-box-equal`

- **construct** — `a captured box exactly equal to the STAGE box (100% × 100%)`
- **why it matters** — The GENERAL form of the 100vh-scrim defect: a measured box that is really the harness, not the component.
- **declared** REFUSED by the name `stage-box` in LEDGER.md
- **measured** — channel `width`; observed on `root`; carried as `root.tokens = 288px`
- **canvas** — ABSENT: a stage-sized box is a measurement artefact, not a component fact
- **verdict** — 🔴 **UNDECLARED-CARRY**: declared REFUSED but the engine CARRIED it — update the manifest

## WRONG-NAME 🔴 — 1

The loss is named — by a message that does not distinguish this construct from any
other. This is the condition that hid Carbon's hollow checkbox: two constructs
collapsing into one indistinguishable receipt.

### `custom-prop-two-hop`

- **construct** — `--a: #123456; --b: var(--a); color: var(--b)`
- **why it matters** — Semantic-over-primitive token layering is TWO hops; the reader follows exactly one.
- **declared** LOWERED by the name `indirection` in source-bindings.json.skips
- **measured** — channel `color`; observed on `root`; carried as `root.tokens = #123456`
- **canvas** — PRESENT: the pixel is right; the NAME is what is at risk
- **verdict** — 🔴 **WRONG-NAME**: carried, but the declared lowering receipt "indirection" is in no artifact — the loss IS named, by a message that does not distinguish this construct from any other

## UNMEASURED 🟡 — the reader never looked — 5

"We never read `::marker`" and "we read it and refused it" are different facts and
get different colours. These are counted, not waived: each is a hole in the reader,
and the count is part of the ratchet.

### `pseudo-backdrop`

- **construct** — `dialog::backdrop { background-color }`
- **why it matters** — The modal scrim. Native <dialog> is how new libraries ship modals, and the scrim IS the token.
- **declared** UNSUPPORTED by the name `::backdrop` in LEDGER.md
- **measured** — channel `background-color`; observed **NOWHERE** — the reader never recorded it; carried **not at all**
- **canvas** — PRESENT: a modal scrim is a real rectangle on the canvas
- **verdict** — 🟡 **UNMEASURED-YELLOW**: the reader never looked at "background-color" — "never read" and "read and refused" are different facts

## What this round cannot yet test

Named, not skipped:

- **Animation.** An infinite `@keyframes` animation is the most common motion
  construct in any design system (spinners), and it cannot enter this fixture
  without risking the double-run byte-identity self-check for the WHOLE round.
  The capture pins infinite animations at `currentTime 0`; that pin is exactly
  what a conformance case should measure, and measuring it needs a per-case
  determinism budget the harness does not have.
- **The canvas half.** Every `canvas:` field in the manifest is a DECLARATION,
  not a measurement: nothing in this round runs the emitted Figma script and
  checks that a construct declared PRESENT actually reaches a node. Until it
  does, "carried" means "reached the contract", not "reached the canvas".
- **State planes and axes.** Every case is one combo with no variant axes, so
  per-state and per-axis correlation — where the MUI and Carbon rounds found
  most of their defects — is untested here.
- **Multi-viewport.** `media-non-matching` proves a non-matching branch is
  invisible; it cannot prove what a second capture at a second viewport would
  do, because the fixture pins one viewport.
- **The three RUN-ABORTED cases** measure nothing downstream of the abort: their
  carriage, naming and canvas behaviour are unknown, not absent.
